source: Sam stepped inside the hole in the mountain, instantly casting Mana Shield, Mana Sense, Mana Sight and conjuring a Light Ball over his head for visibility.
target: Sam in puteum montis intravit, statim incantans Scutum Manae, Sensus Manae, Visum Manae atque globulum Lucis super caput suum evocans ad conspectum.

source: His sword was in his hand, ready to strike and thrumming with mana barely restrained.
target: Gladius eius in manu erat, paratus ad impetum et pulsans cum mana vix continuta.

source: He took a few steps, then turned around and called out.
target: Paucos gradus fecit, deinde se convertit et clamitavit.

source: “Are you coming, ma’am?”
target: «Venis, domina?»

source: There was a moment of silence, and then the giant cricket, still in her smaller form, hopped in front of the cave entrance and faced Sam.
target: Momenti silentii fuit, deinde grylla ingens—adhuc in forma parva—ante ostium speluncae salivit et Sam aspexit.

source: Then, somehow shook her head. Without having a neck…
target: Deinde, quadam ratione, caput suum concussit, cum collum non haberet…

source: “No, child of man. That is your test to see through. I shall stay here and perhaps I may find out why this place seems so familiar…”
target: «Non, puer hominis. Ista est probatio tua ad pervidendum. Hic manebo atque, forsitan, cognoscam cur locus hic tam familiaris appareat…»

source: Sam nodded, relieved yet a little disappointed.
target: Sam caput annuit, solamen inveniens sed paulo deiectus.

source: “Alright! Have fun!”
target: «Recte! Gaude!»

source: Having a powerhouse in his pocket, or rather on top of his head, would have been great, but he didn’t mind leaving the monster behind as he couldn’t exactly control them.
target: Habere virtutem potentem in sinu—vel potius super caput—optimum fuisset, sed non cura eum vexavit monstrum relinquere, quoniam ea regere non poterat.

source: With that squared away, he turned back towards the empty darkness, only illuminated by his Light Ball, and took a step forward.
target: Hoc compositum habens, se iterum convertit ad tenebras vacuas, solum globulo Lucis eius illustratas, et passum in antecessum fecit.

source: Then another and another, until the only thing he could see was the illuminated circle around him, and only hear his own heartbeat and steps reverberating around the corridor filled with rubble and roots poking out of the ceiling.
target: Deinde alterum et alterum, donec sola visio eius fuerat circulus lucidus circa eum, atque tantum audiebat pulsus cordis sui et vestigia gressuum resonantia in corridorum, plenum ruinarum atque radicum ex tecto evidentium.

source: While the Blood Contract was a rather motivating force behind his haste, Sam was actually rather interested in preventing the Ironwood Monster Break.
target: Dum Pactum Sanguinis vis ad festinationem eius fovebat, Sam vero magis studebat Rupturam Monstrorum Ligna Ferrei prohibere.

source: Granted, his first plans were based on that break.
target: Certe, prima consilia eius in eo eventu fundabantur.

source: He planned to amass enough money to buy a few plots that would become valuable after the Break, but now that he had an actual front‐row seat to the event, he was pretty sure he could get something much better than a few plots of land.
target: Consilium habebat argentum satis congregare ut paucas fundias emeret, quae post Rupturam pretiosae fiebant; sed nunc, cum in prima fila eventus sedisset, satis certus erat se aliquid multo melius quam paucas fundias adepturum esse.

source: The quest was rather unique, so Sam didn’t actually have any idea what he would get.
target: Expeditio singularis erat, itaque Sam re vera nesciabat quid consequiturum esset.

source: Even his inherited memories were no help here as the other Sam wasn’t one of the pioneers that died of unique quests every day, so most of his knowledge about these things was from second or sometimes even third-hand.
target: Etiam memoriae hereditatae ei non suffuerunt, quoniam alter Sam non erat unus ex innovatoribus, qui per expeditiones singulares cotidie interirem, itaque plurima notitia eius de his rebus ex testimoniis secundariis vel tertiariis orta erat.

source: Thus, Sam’s gamer senses were tingling…
target: Ita sensus ludi Sam titillabantur…

source: As he walked through the corridors, he made sure to watch out for everything, paying special attention to the ceiling (he read enough stories about the MC hiding up there because ‘nobody looks up’) as he had no need for a surprise monster to the head.
target: Dum per corridoria ambulabat, cuperat omnia observare, maxime attendens laquearia (satis fabularum legit de protagonista illic latente, quia “nemo sursum spectat”) cum monstrum subitaneum in capite ei non opus esset.

source: After five minutes of uneventful walking, dodging rocks on the ground, or giant roots that, over time, managed to break through the hard stone that made up the wall, Sam arrived in a small chamber.
target: Post quinque minuta ambulandi sine incommodis, lapides terreni evitans atque radices ingentes, quae tempore lapidem durum muri constituentem fregere potuerunt, Sam in cellam parvam pervenit.

source: Thankfully, the entrance to the chamber was in a much better shape than the one that lead directly to the outside.
target: Fortunate, ostium cellae in multo meliore statu erat quam ille, qui directe ad foras ducebat.

source: Stepping carefully into the chamber, his senses cranked to the maximum, Sam looked around curiously.
target: Cautissime cellam ingressus, sensus ad summum excitatos habens, Sam circumspiciebat cum curiositate.

source: There wasn’t much.
target: Non erat multum.

source: Another arch, leading deeper inside the mountain, a few benches near the walls and a stone bowl with water dripping into it from a hole in the wall.
target: Altera arcus, quae interiora montis ducebat, pauca subsellia iuxta muros atque urna lapidea, in quam aqua per foram in muro stillabat.

source: Only, so much time had elapsed that the dripping water eroded the stone bowl, so much that it was standing in a small pool that was trickling towards a hole in a nearby wall, made by a root that has long since rotted off.
target: Sed tantum tempus elapsum erat ut aqua stillans urnam lapideam abrasset, ita ut illa in parva piscina steteret, quae versus foram in muro proximo, a radice diu putrescente, fluebatur.

source: His senses told him there was nothing behind the walls either on purpose or hidden, so Sam simply walked around the small pool of water and continued his journey through the arch.
target: Sensus eius significabant nihil post muros esse, nec celatum neque consilio dispositum; itaque Sam circa parvam piscinam aquae ambulavit et iter per arcum continuavit.

source: Sam barely took a few steps when he heard an ominous noise.
target: Sam vix paucos gressus fecit, cum sonum infaustum audivit.

source: It sounded like grinding stone mixed with someone yelling from inside a very deep well.
target: Sonabat quasi lapides molebantur, mixti cum aliquo e intimo puteo vehementer clamante.

source: Tightening the shield around him and channeling a little more mana into his sword, his other ready to unleash some of his meagre amount of skills, he began walking forward cautiously, while the sound continued to come ever so closer.
target: Scutum circa se stringens et paullo maiorem quantitatem mana in gladium suum infundens, cum altera manus ad paucas artes suas emittendas parata, coepit cautus progredi, dum sonus propius accedebat.

source: Finally, his nerves a little frayed, and the unknown entity entered the visible patch of the corridor.
target: Postremo, nervi eius paulo tensi, et ens ignotum in partem visibilem corridoris intravit.

source: It was a mass of rocks, ground and moss, with short stubby legs and arms, no head, just two sinister glowing eyes half-hidden behind moss and other detritus.
target: Erat multitudo lapidum, terrae et muschi, cum cruribus et brachiis brevi et paulum contortis, sine capite, solum duo oculi sinistri fulgentes, partim absconditi post muscum atque reliqua detrita.

source: And to his magical senses, it oozed some kind of black miasma, that caused his stomach to turn.
target: Et sensibus magicis eius apparuit miasma obscurum effluere, quod stomachum eius concitabat.

source: While his attention was fully on the newly revealed monster, Sam still had enough mind to notice the similarities between the miasma coming from the small moss‑slash‑rock golem and the noble lady whose ailment he was planning to heal.
target: Dum tota attentio eius in novo monstrum patefacto versabatur, Sam tamen satis animi habebat ad agnoscendas similitudines inter miasma, quod ex parvo golem musco‑lapideo emanaat, et mulierem nobilem, cuius aegritudinem sanare intendebat.

source: He didn’t have more time to ponder the situation as the little monster, barely reaching his hips raised their hand, roared, filling the corridor with the sound of rocks banging together, and ‘charged’ at him.
target: Non habebat tempus plura meditandi, cum parvum monstrum, vix ad coxas eius attingens, manum levavit et rugivit, corridorem sonitu lapidum inter se percussorum implet, et in eum impetum fecit.

source: At the speed, one would expect a moss‑covered rock to move.
target: Ad velocitatem, quam exspectaretur, saxum musco opertum se moveret.

source: That is, not very fast.
target: Id est, non nimis celeriter.

source: Sam simply sidestepped the ‘speedy’ charge and, with one steady swing, cut the monster in half.
target: Sam impetum celerem facile latius evitavit, et uno ictu constanti monstrum in duas partes secavit.

source: Ignoring the experience point notification, he turned back towards the darkness.
target: Notificatio de punctis experientiae neglecta, se ad tenebras redegit.

source: ‘If all the monsters inside are this type, then it will be ea-‘
target: «Si omnia monstra intus huiusmodi erunt, tunc ea—»

source: His thoughts were however interrupted, as the darkness was suddenly illuminated by dozens of maliciously staring eyes that looked suspiciously like the little golem he killed, and sadly, not all the eyes were at hip level.
target: Sed cogitationes eius interpellatae sunt, cum tenebrae subito a decenis oculis malitiose spectantibus illustratae essent, quae suspiciosae similes erant parvo golem, quem interfecit, et, pro dolore, non omnes oculi ad coxas pertingebant.

source: The next second he was shaken by the roar as hundreds, maybe thousands of moss‑covered golems roared at the same time.
target: Secundo, per rugitum concussus est, cum centena—fortasse milia—golem musco opertorum simul rugirent.

source: Steadying himself, ignoring as the entire mountain shook with the roar, he read the notification that popped up.
target: Firmans se, dum totus mons rugitu tremens appareret, legebat notificationem quae emergebat.

source: “Well, fuck…”
target: «Heu, futue…»

source: Inside his shadow, he could feel Lucky shift, and there was no time to think as the monsters were upon him.
target: In umbra sua sensit Lucky se mutare, et tempus cogitandi non erat, quoniam monstra in eum appropinquabant.

source: They charged at him on the ground, hanging from the walls and even skittering on the ceiling.
target: In terram in eum impetum fecerunt, a muris pendentia atque etiam in laquearibus rapiditer currentes.

source: They were all made of rock and covered by ancient moss, some solid, but most of them were loose rocks and stone fallen from the old stone walls, held together by shadowy miasma.
target: Omnia ex lapide facta erant atque antiquo musco operta; quaedam firma, sed pleraque erant lapides soluti et saxa ex veteribus muris lapsa, coniuncta miasma umbratali.

source: He opened with a wide Mana Slash, creating a gap in the front of the charging monsters, then began a deathly dance.
target: Inchoavit lato Mana Incisio, spatium in fronte monstrorum impetantium creans, et deinde saltationem mortiferam incepit.

source: Striking every monster that came close, making sure that none of them got behind him, while Lucky, like some weird shark, snapped out of his shadow, and with his jaws turning every small monster that got through Sam into powder.
target: Percutiens singulos monstrorum propinquos, cavens ne quis post eum incidat, dum Lucky, velut mirus squalus, ex umbra sua emersit et mandibulis suis omne parvum monstrum, quod per Sam transisset, in pulverem verteret.

source: For every step, he fought, striking down several monsters, ranging in size and shape from small corgi to full‑sized humans, including some terrifying cat‑sized ones, shaped like a spider, that liked to skitter up on the ceiling.
target: Pro quolibet gressu, pugnavit, complura monstra deicens, quarum forma et magnitudo variabant ab parvo cane (corgi) ad integros homines, inter quos erant etiam aliquae, magnitudine felis, quasi araneae similes, quae in laquearibus currere solebant.

source: Those he shot down with simple Wind Blades, and the ones that were fast enough to evade his shots were torn apart by Lucky, who was prowling behind him.
target: Illos deiciebat cum simplicibus Venti Laminis, et qui celeriter ictus eius evadere poterant, Lucky dissecabat, qui post eum se latebat.

source: And thanks to his new skills, Flow and Shadow Footsteps, he was managing to evade most of the thrown rocks.
target: Et novis artibus suis, Flow et Umbrae Vestigia, gratia, pleraque lapides iactatos evitare poterat.

source: With Flow, he could see a sort of wake in front of the monsters with his Mana Sight and, using that, he could predict where they would strike or move.
target: Cum Flow, videre poterat quasi vestigia ante monstris per Visum Manae, atque ea utens, praedicere currorem, ubi impetum facerent vel moverent.

source: It was a fascinating development, but sadly he couldn’t really make use of it anywhere else, as the black miasma dripping from the monsters stood out very well in front of the generally homogenous mana of the mountain and ruin.
target: Evolutio illa admodum mirabilis erat, sed tristiter aliunde uti eam non poterat, cum miasma nigrum, quod ex monstris stillabat, clare eminens appareret coram mana montis et ruinarum uniformi.

source: Maybe when it leveled up…
target: Forsitan, cum gradu suo augebitur…

source: He moved in a circular motion, slashing his sword forward then instantly backward, creating two Mana Slashes in the same instant, then he didn’t even get to watch as two hog‑sized moss golems disintegrated, the miasma sinking into the ground as two more took their place and raised their rather rigid hands to strike Sam.
target: Circuivus motu se movebat, gladium suum ante et deinde subito retro ictu feriens, duo Mana Incisiones eodem momento creans, et deinde ne spectare quidem potuit, cum duo golem musco operti, magnitudine porcorum similes, dissolverentur—miasma in terram submergens—dum alia duo eorum vicem obtinuerunt et manus rigidas ad impetum Sam elevaverunt.

source: Continuing the motion with his sword, he dispatched them with Mana Strikes, then carried on with his journey towards his goal, which his still‑lit Light Ball was starting to illuminate.
target: Perseverans in motu gladii, eos per Mana Incisiones deiecit, atque iter suum ad finem prosequens, quod globus Lucis eius, adhuc lucebat, incipiebat illustrari.

source: As on the edge of the space, he could see thanks to the spell, Sam could see another arch, which hopefully led to a chamber where he could rest.
target: In limite spatii, gratias incantationi, Sam aliam arcum videre poterat, quae—ut sperabat—ad cellam quietis ducebat.

source: Though, he felt that if his luck held up, then it was probably a mini‑boss fight instead of resting…
target: Attamen sensit, si fortuna eius favebat, probabiliter pugna minor ducis esset pro quiete…

source: Slowly but surely, he continued to cut down the monsters that came pouring from beyond the arch, then with a last, heavy step, he crossed a threshold, stepping over slowly dissipating monster corpses and crumbling rocks only to come face to face with a giant chamber, walls crumbling leading to what was, once in the past, rooms.
target: Lente sed certo, monstra quae extra arcum effluere secabat, deinde ultimo gressu gravissimo limen transiunxit, super cadavera monstrorum paulatim dissolventium atque saxa corruentia calcans, ut in facie conveniret cum cella ingenti, cuius muri, in ruina cademus, ad olim cellas ducebantur.

source: And in the middle of the chamber was one giant rock, levitating in the middle. Though it wasn’t whole, as through its spherical body several cracks crisscrossed, filled with the oh‑so‑familiar black miasma.
target: Et in medio cellae erat saxum ingens, levitans; quamquam non integer, cum per corpus sphaericum eius plura fissura intersecabantur et replentur miasma nigro—optime noto.

source: The moment Sam stepped through the arch, there was a stillness in the air and the still‑attacking monster fell back around the giant sphere of rock and miasma while the archway was locked behind him with an opaque black curtain that felt solid under a brief touch.
target: Momento quo Sam per arcum ingressus est, quietis aeris habitus apparuit et monstrum, quod adhuc in impetu erat, circa ingens sphaeram lapidis atque miasma retrocessit, dum introitus post eum clausa esset ab opacis atris velaminibus, firmis sub brevi tactu.

source: Fortunately, Lucky was also fast enough to enter the room.
target: Fortunate, et Lucky celeritate satis habebat ut in cellam intraret.

source: The fluffy wolf stood next to him, tail down and nose pointed at the floating rock and softly growling while the shadows that partially made up his body writhed in apparent anger.
target: Lupus lanuginosus iuxta eum stetit, cauda demissa et naso ad saxum levitans directe, leniter rugiens, dum umbrae, quae partim corpus eius constituebant, in manifesta ira concutarentur.

source: Sam patted the wolf’s head for a few seconds as he took in the situation, absentmindedly noting that Lucky had once again grown.
target: Sam caput lupi per paucos secundos palpat, dum rem contemplabatur, notans insciti quod Lucky iterum cresceret.

source: Then the floating rock pulsed once again, and his Mana Shield dipped a little, and the small monsters congregating around the rock fell apart.
target: Tum saxum levitans rursus pulsavit, et Scutum Manae eius paulum deiecit, atque monstra parva qua saxo circum congregata erant, dissoluta sunt.

source: Sam watched, fascinated, (though he fired off a few Mana Slashes and Wind Blades at the construct, to no results) as the rock, moss, dirt, small roots, and corpses of rodents were slowly mixed together and then rose into the air.
target: Sam spectabat, fascinatō, (quamquam aliquot Mana Incisiones et Venti Laminas in constructum iaciebat, sed frustra) dum saxum, muscus, terra, radicula parva et cadavera murium lente miscēbantur et deinde in aer surgebant.

source: At the same time, the miasma from the rock began to leak out, mixing with the detritus on the ground, hefting it into the air to float around the rock, like asteroids around a planet.
target: Simul, miasma ex saxo effluere coepit, cum detritis in terra miscebat, ea in aer elevans ut circum saxo flueret, velut asteroides circa planetam.

source: Then the dirt orbiting the rock began to take shape, bolstered by the material taken from the rock.
target: Tum terra, quae circum saxo orbita, formam capere coepit, confirmata materia ex saxo collecta.

source: Several seconds later, Sam stood across from a rock golem standing twelve feet tall (cursing cinematic transformations), held together by black miasma, with hundreds of malicious eyes upon its body and a very visible core under all that armor in the middle of its body.
target: Paucis secundis post, Sam adversus golem lapideum, duodecim pedum altitudinis stantem (maledicens transformationes cinematographicas), miasma nigro coniunctum, cum centenis oculorum malitiosorum super corpus eius et nucleo manifeste visibili sub omni armatura in medio eius, stetit.

source: “Well, at least they made it easy to figure it out…” he spoke out loud, then before the enemy golem could finish its first step, he exclaimed.
target: «Bene, saltem id facile inveniendum fecerunt…» in voce edixit, et tum, antequam golem hostilis primum gressum perficeret, exclamavit.

source: “Shadow Burst!”
target: «Eruptio Umbrarum!»

source: Using the superior speed granted by the Shadow Burst skill, his own Mana Body Reinforcement skill, and pumping a little more mana into them than needed, Sam was fast enough to immediately launch himself behind the behemoth.
target: Utendo velocitate superiori tributa per artem Eruptio Umbrarum, propria arte Mana Corpus Confirmatio, et paulo maius mana in ea impendens quam necessario fuit, Sam sufficiente celer erat ut statim se post behemothum jeceret.

source: He arrived, looking up at the craggy back of the golem, which immediately began to slowly turn around.
target: Advenit, intuens ad dorsum asperum golem, qui statim paulatim circumvertere inceperat.

source: Sam didn’t let it. Using Mana Strike, he concentrated a lot of mana into the tip of his sword, and then he thrust with full strength.
target: Sam id non permisit. Usus Mana Incisio, magnam quantitatem mana in aciem gladii sui concentravit, deinde impetu pleno confodit.

source: The sword, enhanced with his mana and supported by his body enhancement, penetrated the back of the golem, the tip of the sword deeply embedded into the core of the monster.
target: Gladius, mana eius auctus et corpore confirmatus, dorsum golem penetravit, acies gladii alte in nucleum monstri insita.

source: Its body frozen in mid-movement, the noise previously filling the chamber vanishing and the miasma also froze as if surprised then it began leaking from the body of the golem, followed by the monster’s body falling apart, while Sam stepped back with a satisfied expression on his face.
target: Corpus eius, in medio motu immobilitum, sonus, qui antea cellam replebat, evanuit, et miasma quoque, quasi obstupefactum, congelatum est, deinde ex corpore golem effluere coepit, cum corpus monstri dissolveretur, dum Sam vultu contento retrorsum gressus fecit.

source: ‘Apparently, the tactics to fight golems are still valid…’ he thought while watching the ‘death throes’ of the golem.
target: «Apparenter, consilia ad golems oppugnandos adhuc valent…» cogitavit, dum exitus mortis golem contemplabatur.

source: Finally, the last piece of rock fell with a small thunk upon the giant pile of rock and dirt in the middle of the room, and Sam was greeted with a small collection of notification screens.
target: Denique, ultima pars lapidis parvo strepitu super ingentem congeriem lapidum atque terrae in medio cellae cecidit, et Sam ex parva collectione monitorum notificationum salutatus est.

source: [Your companion, Lucky, has reached Level 13!]
target: [Socius tuus, Lucky, Gradum XIII attigit!]

source: [Lucky has gained a new skill, Shadow Strike!]
target: [Lucky novam artem adeptus est, Percussio Umbrarum!]

source: [Shadow Strike: Level Max (Active/Passive) All attacks started from the shadows receive bonus damage, and the wolf can clad itself in shadows while striking at an enemy increasing its range of attack.]
target: [Percussio Umbrarum: Gradus Maximus (Activa/Passiva) Omnes impetus, qui ex umbris inchoantur, damnum bonus accipiunt, et lupus se in umbris induere potest dum hosti impetum inferit, ita spatium ictus auget.]

source: Taking a look at the wolf that was now visibly bigger, wagging his tail and curiously sniffing the pile that was a few seconds ago a very threatening golem, Sam shook his head with a wry smile.
target: Aspectans lupum, qui nunc visibiliter maior erat, caudam movebat et curiose congregatum, quod paucis ante golem valde minax fuisset, olfactabat—Sam caput annuit cum risu sardonico.

source: Then he refocused on the screens.
target: Deinde in monitoria se rursus concentravit.

source: [Thanks to fighting in sync with your companion, your skill, Spirit Link has reached Level 12!]
target: [Gratias certamine synchrono cum socio tuo, ars tua Vinculum Spirituum Gradum XII attigit!]

source: [Shadow Footwork has reached Level 3!]
target: [Vestigia Umbrarum Gradum III attigerunt!]

source: [Shadow Burst has reached Level 1!]
target: [Eruptio Umbrarum Gradum I attigit!]

source: [Mana Shield has reached Level 24!]
target: [Scutum Manae Gradus XXIV attigit!]

source: [Sustained Mana Shield has reached Level 2!]
target: [Scutum Manae Sustentatum Gradus II attigit!]

source: It was a pity about Mana Shield as he was looking forward to what would be the Level 25 sub‑skill, but it couldn’t be helped as the fight wasn’t really dangerous, so he didn’t really need to use it much. The most damage it suffered was when the dark miasma tried to strike at him directly.
target: Dolet de Scuto Manae, cum exspectaret quid sub‑ars Gradus XXV futurum esset, sed nihil efficere poterat, quoniam pugna non vere periculosa erat; ideo non multum usui eius indigens fuit. Maxima damna passi sunt cum miasma obscurum directe in eum impetum facere conatus est.

source: [Light Ball has reached Level 6!]
target: [Globus Lucis Gradus VI attigit!]

source: [Wind Blade has reached Level 7!]
target: [Lamina Ventorum Gradus VII attigit!]

source: [Mage Sight has reached Level 7!]
target: [Visus Magi Gradus VII attigit!]

source: [Mana Strike reached Level 9!]
target: [Mana Incisio Gradus IX attigit!]

source: [Efficient Mana Slash has reached level 1!]
target: [Mana Incisio Efficax Gradus I attigit!]

source: [Mana Body Enhancement has reached level 19!]
target: [Mana Corpus Amplificatio Gradus XIX attigit!]

source: [Flow has reached Level 3!]
target: [Flow Gradus III attigit!]

source: [Multitasking has reached level 39!]
target: [Multitasking Gradus XXXIX attigit!]

source: Then came his favorite notification.
target: Deinde venit notificatio eius praedilecta.

source: [Thanks to your dedication to your craft, you managed to perform two Mana Slashes almost at the same time, granting you the Double Mana Slash skill!]
target: [Gratias dedicationi erga artem tuam, duas Mana Incisiones fere simul perficere potuisti, tibi donans artem Duo Mana Incisio!]

source: [Double Mana Slash: Level 0/10 (0%) (Active) Allows you to enhance the damage of your slashes with any weapon capable of slashing while slashing so fast it doubles the effect. The sub‑skills of Mana Slash also affect this skill.]
target: [Duo Mana Incisio: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Activa) Permittit tibi damnum incisionum tuarum augere cum quolibet armis, quod incidere potest, dum tam celeriter incidis ut effectum duplicet. Sub‑artes Mana Incisio hanc artem quoque afficiunt.]

source: It was a simple concept, doing two slashes after each other fast enough that there was barely any pause between them, but it took some practice.
target: Conceptus ille simplex erat: duas incisiones sequentibus tam celeriter perficere ut paulum inter eas interponeret, sed tamen exercitationem quaesivit.

source: Luckily, he had some practice time with the giant grasshoppers, so he finally managed to do it against the miasma golems.
target: Fortunate, tempus exercitationis cum magnis locustis habuit, ita ut tandem id contra golems miasmaticos efficere posset.

source: Finally, he dealt with his lone level up.
target: Denique, gradum suum unicum adeptus est.

source: [Congratulations! You’ve leveled up!]
target: [Felicitationes! Gradum adeptus es!]

source: [You’re now Level 20!]
target: [Nunc es Gradus XX!]

source: [Gained 2 unassigned attribute points!]
target: [Acquisisti 2 puncta attributa non assignata!]

source: [Gained 1 END point for enduring everything that rose against you!]
target: [Acquisisti 1 punctum END pro sustinendis cunctis adversitatibus!]

source: [Gained 1 AGI for demonstrating speed above the average man!]
target: [Acquisisti 1 AGI pro ostendendo celeritatem supra mediocris hominem!]

source: Sam added the two extra points to AGI and DEX respectively, as he had enough MAG for now.
target: Sam duas puncta extra ad AGI et DEX respective adiecit, cum pro praesenti satis MAG haberet.

source: He now needed to bring his body up to a satisfactory level.
target: Nunc debebat corpus suum ad gradum satisfaciendum adducere.

source: Then, when he was finished reviewing the changes, he made sure to check over his sword as he was fighting rock golems, but thanks to running mana through it, the sword didn’t suffer any damage.
target: Deinde, cum mutationes recognovisset, certus fuit gladium suum inspicere, dum contra golem lapideos pugnabat; at, per fluxum mana per gladium, illud nullum damnum passi est.

source: Following that, he began the age‑old tradition of digging for loot.
target: Postea, antiquam consuetudinem praediandi fodiendi incepit.

source: Sadly, the only thing he found was a small marble‑sized and shaped bright white crystal in the middle of the pile of rock left behind.
target: Tristiter, solum quod invenit fuit parvus crystallus candidus, marmoreae magnitudinis et figurae, in medio congeriem lapidum relictorum.

source: Sam lifted the small crystal to his eyes and fully focused all of his skill upon it.
target: Sam parvum crystallum ad oculos levavit et totam artem suam in eum penitus concentravit.

source: But the only thing he could sense was a very dense concentration of raw, unadulterated nature mana.
target: Sed solum quod percipere poterat, erat densissima concentratio mana naturae crudae et inconditae.

source: The same mana he could sense in the symbols he followed to this place.
target: Eadem mana, quam per symbola, quae eum ad hunc locum duxerunt, percipiebat.

source: “So, this is one of the keys right?”
target: «Ita, haec una clavis est, recte?»

source: Lucky just huffed in agreement, and Sam nodded, then placed the marble into his inventory, took another look around the chamber, and then stepped through the only arch that didn’t lead to a room full of fallen rocks and plants that thrived in the darkness.
target: Lucky leviter suspiravit in approbatione, et Sam caput annuit, deinde marmorem in inventarium suum posuit, cellam iterum circumspexit, atque per unicam arcum, quae non ad cellam lapidum cadentium et plantarum in tenebris vigentium ducebat, ingreditus est.

source: Unsurprisingly, he was once again met with hundreds of maliciously glowing eyes, all staring hungrily at him.
target: Non mirum, iterum centena oculorum malitiosorum fulgentium eum occurrere videntur, omnesque ad eum famelice spectabant.

source: He lifted his sword up, and his other hand shone with the light of mana.
target: Gladium suum sublevavit, et altera manus eius luce mana refulgebat.

source: The ground shook, the monsters roared, and the mountain also began to shake, causing dirt and dust to fall on Sam’s and Lucky’s heads.
target: Terra tremuit, monstra rugiverunt, et mons quoque tremere coepit, unde terra et pulvis in capita Sam et Lucky cadebant.

source: Lucky answered with his own howl, and Sam only had one thing to say.
target: Lucky suo ululatu respondebat, et Sam unum tantum verbum habebat.

source: “Shadow Burst!”
target: «Eruptio Umbrarum!»
